scientific_integrity: Claimed analytical proof; finite script is supporting verification, not infinite certification. Classical run counts and uniform Bessel bounds are attributed to published antecedents.
scientific_limitations: Even, exactly balanced, symmetric Markov sign words; diverging expected switches with T_N^2/N -> 0; no fixed-persistence or general-bridge assertion. Priority remains independently unaudited; the 1996 conditional-runs article was not accessible in full.
title: Independent Poisson extremes for colored runs in balanced rare-switch walks
